title: Soft navigation to Calendar retains prior active @contextRail slot instead of mounting root fallback
reproduction_command: Navigate from /portfolio to /calendar via client NavRail link; observe retained Portfolio rail; refresh page to observe default rail.
expected: Navigating to /calendar mounts the root @contextRail fallback (default.tsx) consistently across both client soft navigation and hard page reload.
actual: Client soft navigation retains the preceding route's active rail (e.g. Portfolio Greek totals) until hard browser reload occurs.

title: Soft navigation to Settings retains prior active @contextRail slot instead of mounting root fallback
reproduction_command: Navigate from /watchlist to /settings via client NavRail link; observe retained Watchlist rail; refresh page to observe default rail.
expected: Navigating to /settings mounts the root @contextRail fallback (default.tsx) consistently across both client soft navigation and hard page reload.
actual: Client soft navigation retains the preceding route's active rail (e.g. Watchlist status counts) until hard browser reload occurs.

title: Appearance row density selection resets visually when switching Settings sub-sections
reproduction_command: Open /settings, select 'Compact' density, click 'Brokers' in sub-navigation, then click back to 'Appearance'.
expected: The 'Compact' density radio selection remains selected reflecting active theme store state.
actual: The Appearance form remounts and resets local density radio button state to default 'Comfortable' while root HTML data-density remains compact.

title: Settings footer confirms 'Saved' after a failed or unsubmitted backend save
reproduction_command: Simulate network error (HTTP 500 or offline) and click 'Save Settings' in Risk or Strategy scan section.
expected: Error message displayed and 'Saved' confirmation suppressed.
actual: Footer briefly displays green 'Saved' indicator before or regardless of network failure, misleading operator on persistence outcome.

title: Chart canvas lacks an accessible DOM table or ARIA text alternative for assistive inspection
reproduction_command: Navigate to /chart and tab through CandlestickChart using a screen reader.
expected: Chart area exposes an off-screen semantic data table or detailed ARIA description detailing high/low/close candlestick metrics.
actual: Lightweight-charts renders purely into an HTML5 <canvas> element without fallback subtree; assistive tech only reads generic header text.

title: Step 2 Universe market-cap filter inputs show generic '$' label without millions unit indicator
reproduction_command: Open /screener/step-2-universe and inspect market-cap filter labels vs payload dispatched to backend.
expected: Market cap input label explicitly indicates '(in $M)' or '$ Millions' to match options backend unit expectations.
actual: Label displays generic '$' which leads operators to enter raw dollar amounts instead of millions, causing unexpected empty scan results.
